messages:
incident-bot: [EMERGENCY ALERT] org=fjordly — sustained token/sec spike (~4x baseline) + rising 5xx rate on us-east inference pool. Paging oncall now. dashboard: /d/fjordly/overview
oncall-robin: I'm on it. grabbing logs and will check routing/rl first.
oncall-robin: snapshot: errors increased at 13:02 UTC, p95 latency up 3x, KV-cache miss rate up 60%
sre-jin: logged in, looking at their traffic pattern — lots of many small streaming requests and some huge context sizes (>= 8k tokens). appears to be a sudden feature flip on their side.
alex_prod: fjordly is on tier: hosted-standard, no reserved capacity. CS reached out to customer via email; they say a new pre-release was rolled at 12:58 UTC.
elaine_pm: @oncall-robin main ask: keep customer online while protecting platform. avoid full org cutoff if possible.
ops-liaison: recommend emergency soft-throttle first (rate cap per org) + reduce max_tokens and disable streaming for that org to limit open connections.
sre-jin: proposed mitigations:
```
# emergency actions
# 1) soft throttle org to 12 rps (gradual) for 20m
/rl override --org=fjordly --rate=12rps --type=soft --expires=20m --by=oncall-robin
# 2) set per-request token cap
/config set org=fjordly max_tokens=256 --expires=20m
# 3) disable streaming for org temporarily
/config set org=fjordly streaming_enabled=false --expires=20m
```
oncall-robin: executing now. will apply one by one and observe.
deploy-bot: /rl override --org=fjordly --rate=12rps --type=soft --expires=20m — SUCCESS (applied to us-east and eu-west).
ops-liaison: :thumbsup: please apply token cap next.
oncall-robin: /config set org=fjordly max_tokens=256 --expires=20m — SUCCESS
robin: /config set org=fjordly streaming_enabled=false --expires=20m — SUCCESS. Notifying customer.
cs-tom: FYI I've opened a support DM to fjordly and flagged the mitigation. They've acknowledged and said they'll roll back the pre-release if needed.
sre-jin: metrics update: 13:10 UTC — error rate down ~70%, p95 latency back to ~1.2x baseline, token/sec dropping. KV-cache miss still slightly elevated.
oncall-robin: good. leaving the soft-throttle in place for now and will extend if needed. starting a mitigation handoff to night oncall in 25m.
elaine_pm: capture this for post-incident — we should evaluate guardrails for sudden feature rollouts per org (auto-detect large context growth).
alex_prod: consider offering a one-time credits/billing adjustment if customer affected; CS will coordinate after postmortem.
ops-liaison: action items recorded: 1) postmortem (owner: oncall-robin) 2) follow-up with fjordly (owner: cs-tom) 3) run model routing rules to prefer smaller-quantized variants for high-token bursts (owner: sre-jin).
oncall-robin: handing off to @sre-jin for overnight watch. I'll add notes to the incident channel and open the postmortem doc.
sre-jin: ack — monitoring dashboards and alerts adjusted, will escalate if any regressions.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied — soft-throttle + token cap + streaming disabled. Customer contacted. Incident severity reduced to SEV3.
cs-tom: fjordly confirms decreased error rate on their side too. they plan to roll back the pre-release in next hour.
elaine_pm: thanks team. we should reconvene for a 30m write-up tomorrow AM. :coffee:
